package.name: grasp_node_cpp
package.description: rclcpp grasp node: RGB-D depth in on /camera/depth/image_raw, JointTrajectory out on /grasp/joint_trajectory, one GraspLatency record per frame on /grasp/latency. Also ships frame_publisher, a live stand-in for the camera that stamps at publish time so end-to-end latency is measurable.
